title: Qin rulers connect earlier fortifications
summary: Under Qin Shi Huang, sections of older fortifications were linked into a defence system around 220 BCE. The walls associated with later dynasties represent further, separate stages of construction.

Approximate year; no claim that the whole modern wall dates to this phase.
The Great Wall is a history of repeated building rather than one monument completed at a single moment. This record preserves the difference between a Qin-era project and later surviving structures.
